---
name: Template Request
about: Request a new LaTeX template
title: '[TEMPLATE] '
labels: template, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Template Type
What type of template are you requesting?

## Purpose
What is the template intended for? (e.g., conference paper, lab report, project proposal)

## Target Audience
Who would use this template? (e.g., students, researchers, professionals)

## Requirements
What features or elements should this template include?
- [ ] Title page
- [ ] Abstract
- [ ] Table of contents
- [ ] Bibliography
- [ ] Multiple columns
- [ ] Specific formatting (describe below)
- [ ] Other (please specify)

## Specific Formatting Requirements
Describe any specific formatting requirements (e.g., IEEE format, APA style, specific margins).

## Reference Examples
Do you have examples of documents that follow the desired format? Please provide links or references.

## Existing Templates
Are there similar templates that could be adapted? If so, please link to them.

## Additional Context
Any other information that would help in creating this template.

## Willingness to Contribute
- [ ] I can provide a draft template
- [ ] I can provide example content
- [ ] I can test the template
- [ ] I'd like someone else to create this
